column3: Check
No page has horizontal scroll or clipped content at phone width (~375px) and tablet width (~768px+)
Bottom nav never overlaps page content; on a notch/home-indicator device the nav sits above the home indicator not behind it
Thai text (longer than English on buttons/labels) never overflows or wraps awkwardly on a narrow screen
Rotating the device portrait to landscape and back does not break the layout lose scroll position or reload the page unexpectedly
On /map the map area fills the screen correctly even as the browser's address bar collapses/expands while scrolling
Pinch to zoom in/out is smooth (not jumpy or stuck between only two sizes)
One-finger drag pans the map smoothly; dragging while zoomed out fully never loses the map off-screen
Tapping a small store plot selects that exact plot and not a neighboring one
Tapping a checkpoint pin opens that checkpoint's detail sheet reliably on the first tap
As admin: the show-empty-plots toggle button, photo upload tile, and photo delete (x) buttons are all easy to tap without mis-tapping something else
The bottom sheet opens and closes cleanly (tap outside or the close button) and never gets stuck half-open
Opening /scan prompts for camera permission and allowing it shows a live video feed within a few seconds
Denying camera permission falls back to the manual code-entry box without crashing the page
Scanning a real printed/displayed QR code is detected reliably in normal indoor lighting
Switching to another app mid-scan and returning does not leave the camera frozen or require a page reload
Tapping อัปโหลดรูป offers the native choice between taking a photo and picking from the library
A full-resolution phone photo (HEIC on iPhone several MB) uploads successfully and displays as a thumbnail
Uploading over a slow mobile connection shows the กำลังอัปโหลด state and does not let you double-submit
Tapping a text field focuses it and the on-screen keyboard never covers that field or its submit button
The email field shows an email-style keyboard (with @) and the password field masks input and offers a show/hide toggle if present
The browser's/OS's saved-password autofill suggestion works normally on login and signup
The camera preview and winner-frame overlay render correctly and ถ่ายภาพ captures a usable image
เลือกรูปภาพจากคลัง works correctly when camera access is denied
The app works over real mobile data (not just wifi) without the live map sync (SSE) hanging or erroring
Session stays logged in after backgrounding the browser/app for a while and returning
Dark/light mode follows the device's OS setting correctly on first load
